div.head: II Cn 30.9
div.ab: ⁊ gif heo forð ne cume, fo se cingc to þam were. ⁊ beo se þeof utlah wið eal folc.
And gif he forð ne cume, fo se cynincg to þam were. ⁊ beo seo þeof utlah wið eall folc.
Si deficiat, habeat rex ipsam wéram; et fur apud omnem populum útlaga sit.
⁊ gif heo] forð ne cume, fo se cyng to þam wére ⁊ beo seo þeof utlah wið eal folc.
And gif heo forð ne cume, fo se cingc to þam were and beo se þeof utlah wið eal folc.
And if he fails, the king shall take the wergeld, and the thief shall be treated as an outlaw by the whole nation.
And if it does not succeed, the king shall take his wergild and the thief shall be adjudged an outlaw by the entire realm.
And if it does not succeed, the king is to succeed to the wergild, and the thief is to be an outlaw as regards the whole people.
Und wenn sie nicht zu Stande kommt, erhalte der König dies Wergeld. Und jener Dieb sei friedlos beim ganzen Volke.
And if it does not succeed, let the king take that wergild. And let the thief be an outlaw with respect to the whole people.
